reasoning_traces.think:
ELATE's core innovation lies in treating time-series feature engineering as an evolutionary search problem over a space of pandas code snippets. Each generation evolves a population of features, guided by a prompt template that enforces temporal causality. The objective function minimizes prediction error E(φ(T, X), y), where φ applies transformations column-wise to the input time series T. This formulation allows for deep compositional features without greedy reward shaping, unlike CAAFE. The use of code strings instead of numerical vectors ensures reproducibility and adaptability to new data. The temperature schedule T(n) = T0·e^(-K·n/Nmax) + ε balances exploration (early) and exploitation (late), enabling efficient convergence. In GSI, this framework supports Bayesian inference over evolving sports narratives, while in GSE, it enables rapid feature composition for situational reasoning.
